2
3use std::collections::{BTreeSet, HashMap, HashSet};
4
5use font_types::{FixedSize, GlyphId16, Offset16};
6use read_fonts::tables::{
7    gpos::{self as rgpos, ValueFormat},

11use super::{Graph, ObjectId};

14pub(crate) fn split_pair_pos(graph: &mut Graph, lookup: ObjectId) {
15    super::split_subtables(graph, lookup, split_pair_pos_subtable)
16}
17
18fn split_pair_pos_subtable(graph: &mut Graph, lookup: ObjectId) -> Option<Vec<ObjectId>> {
19    let data = &graph.objects[&lookup];
20    let format: u16 = data.read_at(0).unwrap();
21    match format {
22        1 => split_pair_pos_format_1(graph, lookup),
23        2 => split_pair_pos_format_2(graph, lookup),
24        other => {
25            log::warn!("unexpected pairpos format '{other}'");
26            None
27        }
28    }
29}

31// based off of
32// <https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfbuzz/blob/5d543d64222c6ce45332d0c188790f90691ef112/src/graph/pairpos-graph.hh#L50>
33fn split_pair_pos_format_1(graph: &mut Graph, subtable: ObjectId) -> Option<Vec<ObjectId>> {
34    const BASE_SIZE: usize = 5 * u16::RAW_BYTE_LEN;
35
36    let data = &graph.objects[&subtable];
37
38    debug_assert!(data.reparse::<rgpos::PairPosFormat1>().is_ok());
39    let coverage_id = data.offsets.first().unwrap();
40    assert_eq!(coverage_id.pos, 2, "offset records are always sorted");
41    let coverage_size = graph.objects[&coverage_id.object].bytes.len();
42
43    let mut visited = HashSet::with_capacity(data.offsets.len());
44
45    let mut partial_coverage_size = 4;
46    let mut accumulated = BASE_SIZE;
47    let mut split_points = Vec::new();
48
49    for (i, pair_set_off) in data.offsets.iter().skip(1).enumerate() {
50        let table_size = if visited.insert(pair_set_off.object) {
51            let pairset = &graph.objects[&pair_set_off.object];
52            // the size of the pairset table itself
53            let mut subgraph_size = pairset.bytes.len();
54            // now we add the lengths of any new device tables. we do *not*
55            // deduplicate these, even within the graph, since it is possible
56            // that they will need to be re-duplicated later in some cases?
57            // TODO: investigate whether there are any wins here?
58            // <https://github.com/googlefonts/fontations/issues/596>
59            subgraph_size += pairset
60                .offsets
61                .iter()
62                .map(|off| graph.objects[&off.object].bytes.len())
63                .sum::<usize>();
64            subgraph_size
65        } else {
66            0
67        };
68        let accumulated_delta = table_size +
69            // the offset to the table
70            Offset16::RAW_BYTE_LEN;
71        // another glyph in the coverage table
72        partial_coverage_size += u16::RAW_BYTE_LEN;
73        accumulated += accumulated_delta;
74        let total = accumulated + coverage_size.min(partial_coverage_size);
75        if total > super::MAX_TABLE_SIZE {
76            log::trace!("adding split at {i}");
77            split_points.push(i);
78            accumulated = BASE_SIZE + accumulated_delta;
79            partial_coverage_size = 6; // + one glyph, because this table didn't fit
80            visited.clear();
81        }
82    }
83
84    log::debug!(
85        "nothing to split, size '{}'",
86        accumulated + coverage_size.min(partial_coverage_size)
87    );
88
89    if split_points.is_empty() {
90        return None;
91    }
92
93    split_points.push(data.offsets.len() - 1);
94    // okay, now we have a list of split points.
95
96    let mut new_subtables = Vec::new();
97    let mut prev_split = 0;
98    for next_split in split_points {
99        // the split point is the *start* of the next subtable, so we do not
100        // include this item in this subtable
101        let new_subtable = split_off_ppf1(graph, subtable, prev_split, next_split);
102        prev_split = next_split;
103        new_subtables.push(graph.add_object(new_subtable));
104    }
105    Some(new_subtables)
106}
107
108fn split_off_ppf1(graph: &mut Graph, subtable: ObjectId, start: usize, end: usize) -> TableData {
109    let coverage = graph.objects[&subtable].offsets.first().unwrap().object;
110    let coverage = graph.objects.get(&coverage).unwrap();
111    let coverage = coverage.reparse::<rlayout::CoverageTable>().unwrap();
112    let n_pair_sets = end - start;
113    let new_coverage = super::split_coverage(&coverage, start as u16, end as u16);
114    let new_cov_id = graph.add_object(new_coverage);
115
116    let data = &graph.objects[&subtable];
117    let table = data.reparse::<rgpos::PairPosFormat1>().unwrap();
118
119    let mut new_ppf1 = TableData::new(data.type_);
120
121    new_ppf1.write(table.pos_format());
122    new_ppf1.add_offset(new_cov_id, 2, 0);
123    new_ppf1.write(table.value_format1());
124    new_ppf1.write(table.value_format2());
125    new_ppf1.write(n_pair_sets as u16);
126    for off in data.offsets[1 + start..].iter().take(n_pair_sets as _) {
127        new_ppf1.add_offset(off.object, 2, 0)
128    }
129    new_ppf1
130}

132// based off of
133// <https://github.com/harfbuzz/harfbuzz/blob/f380a32825a1b2c51bbe21dc7acb9b3cc0921f69/src/graph/pairpos-graph.hh#L207>
134fn split_pair_pos_format_2(graph: &mut Graph, subtable: ObjectId) -> Option<Vec<ObjectId>> {
135    // the minimum size of a format 2 subtable
136    const BASE_SIZE: usize = 8 * u16::RAW_BYTE_LEN;
137    let data = &graph.objects[&subtable];
138
139    let pp2 = data.reparse::<rgpos::PairPosFormat2>().unwrap();
140    let cur_len = data.bytes.len();
141    log::info!(
142        "PairPos f.2 subtable has {} class1 and {} class2, current size {cur_len} ",
143        pp2.class1_count(),
144        pp2.class2_count()
145    );
146    // we can't get these from the reparsed table because its offsets
147    // are not valid until compiled into the final table
148    let coverage_id = data.offsets[0].object;
149    let class_def1_id = data.offsets[1].object;
150    let class_def2_id = data.offsets[2].object;
151    let class_def2_size = graph.objects[&class_def2_id].bytes.len();
152    let coverage = &graph.objects[&coverage_id];
153    let coverage = coverage.reparse::<rlayout::CoverageTable>().unwrap();
154
155    let class_def1 = &graph.objects[&class_def1_id];
156    let class_def1 = class_def1.reparse::<rlayout::ClassDef>().unwrap();
157    let estimator = ClassDefSizeEstimator::new(coverage, class_def1);
158
159    let class2_count = pp2.class2_count();
160    let class1_record_size = class2_count as usize
161        * (pp2.value_format1().record_byte_len() + pp2.value_format2().record_byte_len());
162
163    let mut accumulated = BASE_SIZE;
164    let mut coverage_size = 4;
165    let mut class_def_1_size = 4;
166
167    let mut split_points = Vec::new();
168    let has_device_tables = (pp2.value_format1() | pp2.value_format2())
169        .intersects(rgpos::ValueFormat::ANY_DEVICE_OR_VARIDX);
170
171    let mut visited = HashSet::new();
172    let mut next_device_offset = 3; // start after coverage + class defs
173    for (idx, class1rec) in pp2.class1_records().iter().enumerate() {
174        let mut accumulated_delta = class1_record_size;
175        coverage_size += estimator.increment_coverage_size(idx as _);
176        class_def_1_size += estimator.increment_class_def_size(idx as _);
177
178        if has_device_tables {
179            for class2rec in class1rec.unwrap().class2_records.iter() {
180                let class2rec = class2rec.as_ref().unwrap();
181                accumulated_delta += size_of_value_record_children(
182                    &class2rec.value_record1,
183                    graph,
184                    &data.offsets,
185                    &mut next_device_offset,
186                    &mut visited,
187                );
188                accumulated_delta += size_of_value_record_children(
189                    &class2rec.value_record2,
190                    graph,
191                    &data.offsets,
192                    &mut next_device_offset,
193                    &mut visited,
194                );
195            }
196        }
197
198        accumulated += accumulated_delta;
199        let largest_obj = coverage_size.max(class_def_1_size).max(class_def2_size);
200        let total = accumulated + coverage_size + class_def_1_size + class_def2_size
201        // largest obj packs last and can overflow (we only point to the start)
202        - largest_obj;
203
204        if total > super::MAX_TABLE_SIZE {
205            split_points.push(idx);
206            // split does not include this class, so add it for the next iteration
207            accumulated = BASE_SIZE + accumulated_delta;
208            coverage_size = 4 + estimator.increment_coverage_size(idx as _);
209            class_def_1_size = 4 + estimator.increment_class_def_size(idx as _);
210            visited.clear();
211        }
212    }
213
214    log::debug!("identified {} split points", split_points.len());
215    if split_points.is_empty() {
216        return None;
217    }
218
219    split_points.push(pp2.class1_count() as usize);
220    // now we have a list of split points, and just need to do the splitting.
221    // note: harfbuzz does a thing here with a context type and an 'actuate_splits'
222    // method.
223
224    let mut new_subtables = Vec::new();
225    let mut prev_split = 0;
226    let mut next_device_offset = 3; // after coverage & two class defs
227    for next_split in split_points {
228        let (new_subtable, offsets_used) =
229            split_off_ppf2(graph, subtable, prev_split, next_split, next_device_offset);
230        prev_split = next_split;
231        next_device_offset += offsets_used;
232        new_subtables.push(graph.add_object(new_subtable));
233    }
234
235    Some(new_subtables)
236}

238// returns the new table, + the number of non-null device offsets encountered.
239fn split_off_ppf2(
240    graph: &mut Graph,
241    subtable: ObjectId,
242    start: usize,
243    end: usize,
244    first_device_idx: usize,
245) -> (TableData, usize) {
246    // we have to do this bit manually (instead of via reparsing) because of borrowk
247    let coverage = graph.objects[&subtable].offsets.first().unwrap().object;
248    let coverage = graph.objects.get(&coverage).unwrap();
249    let coverage = coverage.reparse::<rlayout::CoverageTable>().unwrap();
250    let class_def_1 = graph.objects[&subtable].offsets[1].object;
251    let class_def_1 = graph.objects.get(&class_def_1).unwrap();
252    let class_def_1 = class_def_1.reparse::<rlayout::ClassDef>().unwrap();
253
254    let class1_count = end - start;
255    log::trace!("splitting off {class1_count} class1records ({start}..={end})");
256
257    let class_map = coverage
258        .iter()
259        .filter_map(|gid| {
260            let glyph_class = class_def_1.get(gid);
261            (start..end)
262                .contains(&(glyph_class as usize))
263                // classes are used as indexes, so adjust them
264                .then_some((gid, glyph_class.saturating_sub(start as u16)))
265        })
266        .collect::<HashMap<_, _>>();
267
268    let new_coverage = class_map
269        .keys()
270        .copied()
271        .collect::<wlayout::CoverageTable>();
272    let new_coverage = super::make_table_data(&new_coverage);
273    let new_cov_id = graph.add_object(new_coverage);
274    let new_class_def1 = class_map
275        .iter()
276        .map(|tup| (*tup.0, *tup.1))
277        .collect::<wlayout::ClassDef>();
278    let new_class_def1 = super::make_table_data(&new_class_def1);
279    let new_class_def1_id = graph.add_object(new_class_def1);
280    // we reuse class2 without changing it. maybe we could be changing it?
281    let class_def_2_id = graph.objects[&subtable].offsets[2].object;
282
283    let data = &graph.objects[&subtable];
284    let table = data.reparse::<rgpos::PairPosFormat2>().unwrap();
285    let value_format1 = table.value_format1();
286    let value_format2 = table.value_format2();
287
288    let mut new_ppf2 = TableData::new(data.type_);
289    new_ppf2.write(table.pos_format());
290    new_ppf2.add_offset(new_cov_id, 2, 0);
291    new_ppf2.write(value_format1);
292    new_ppf2.write(value_format2);
293    new_ppf2.add_offset(new_class_def1_id, 2, 0);
294    new_ppf2.add_offset(class_def_2_id, 2, 0);
295    new_ppf2.write(class1_count as u16);
296    new_ppf2.write(table.class2_count());
297
298    // now we need to copy over the class1records
299    let mut seen_offsets = 0;
300    for class2rec in table
301        .class1_records()
302        .iter()
303        .skip(start)
304        .take(class1_count)
305        .flat_map(|c1rec| {
306            c1rec
307                .unwrap()
308                .class2_records()
309                .iter()
310                .map(|rec| rec.unwrap())
311        })
312    {
313        let rec_offset_start = first_device_idx + seen_offsets;
314        let rec_offsets = &graph.objects[&subtable].offsets[rec_offset_start..];
315        let rec1_seen = copy_value_rec(
316            &mut new_ppf2,
317            class2rec.value_record1(),
318            value_format1,
319            rec_offsets,
320        );
321        let rec_offsets = &rec_offsets[rec1_seen..];
322        seen_offsets += rec1_seen;
323        seen_offsets += copy_value_rec(
324            &mut new_ppf2,
325            class2rec.value_record2(),
326            value_format2,
327            rec_offsets,
328        );
329    }
330    (new_ppf2, seen_offsets)
331}

333// returns the number of non-null offsets encountered in this record
334fn copy_value_rec(
335    target: &mut TableData,
336    rec: &rgpos::ValueRecord,
337    format: ValueFormat,
338    dev_offsets: &[OffsetRecord],
339) -> usize {
340    let mut seen_offsets = 0;
341    // a little macro to help us copy over all the fields.
342    // - first we copy over the non-device tables
343    // - then for the device tables, if they are present we copy over
344    // the id.
345    macro_rules! write_opt_field {
346        ($fld:ident) => {
347            if let Some(val) = rec.$fld() {
348                target.write(val);
349            }
350        };
351        ($fld:ident, $flag:expr) => {
352            if !rec.$fld.get().is_null() {
353                // we write this in a funny way to dodge a clippy warning
354                seen_offsets += 1;
355                target.add_offset(dev_offsets[seen_offsets - 1].object, 2, 0);
356            } else if $flag {
357                target.write(0u16); // null offset
358            }
359        };
360    }
361    write_opt_field!(x_placement);
362    write_opt_field!(y_placement);
363    write_opt_field!(x_advance);
364    write_opt_field!(y_advance);
365
366    write_opt_field!(
367        x_placement_device,
368        format.contains(ValueFormat::X_PLACEMENT_DEVICE)
369    );
370    write_opt_field!(
371        y_placement_device,
372        format.contains(ValueFormat::Y_PLACEMENT_DEVICE)
373    );
374    write_opt_field!(
375        x_advance_device,
376        format.contains(ValueFormat::X_ADVANCE_DEVICE)
377    );
378    write_opt_field!(
379        y_advance_device,
380        format.contains(ValueFormat::Y_ADVANCE_DEVICE)
381    );
382    seen_offsets
383}

385struct ClassDefSizeEstimator {
386    consecutive_gids: bool,
387    num_ranges_per_class: HashMap<u16, u16>,
388    glyphs_per_class: HashMap<u16, BTreeSet<GlyphId16>>,
389}
390
391const GLYPH_SIZE: usize = std::mem::size_of::<u16>();
392
393impl ClassDefSizeEstimator {
394    fn new(coverage: rlayout::CoverageTable, classdef: rlayout::ClassDef) -> Self {
395        let mut consecutive_gids = true;
396        let mut last_gid = None;
397        let mut glyphs_per_class = HashMap::new();
398        for (gid, class) in coverage.iter().map(|gid| (gid, classdef.get(gid))) {
399            if let Some(last) = last_gid.take() {
400                if last + 1 != gid.to_u16() {
401                    consecutive_gids = false;
402                }
403            }
404            last_gid = Some(gid.to_u16());
405            glyphs_per_class
406                .entry(class)
407                .or_insert(BTreeSet::default())
408                .insert(gid);
409        }
410
411        // now compute the number of ranges manually, skipping class 0
412        let mut num_ranges_per_class = HashMap::with_capacity(glyphs_per_class.len());
413        for (class, glyphs) in glyphs_per_class.iter().filter(|x| *x.0 != 0) {
414            let num_ranges = count_num_ranges(glyphs);
415            num_ranges_per_class.insert(*class, num_ranges);
416        }
417        ClassDefSizeEstimator {
418            consecutive_gids,
419            num_ranges_per_class,
420            glyphs_per_class,
421        }
422    }
423
424    fn n_glyphs_in_class(&self, class: u16) -> usize {
425        self.glyphs_per_class
426            .get(&class)
427            .map(BTreeSet::len)
428            .unwrap_or_default()
429    }
430
431    fn increment_coverage_size(&self, class: u16) -> usize {
432        GLYPH_SIZE * self.n_glyphs_in_class(class)
433    }
434
435    fn increment_class_def_size(&self, class: u16) -> usize {
436        // classdef2 uses 6 bytes for each range (start, end, class)
437        const SIZE_PER_RANGE: usize = 6;
438        let class_def_2_size = SIZE_PER_RANGE
439            * self
440                .num_ranges_per_class
441                .get(&class)
442                .copied()
443                .unwrap_or_default() as usize;
444        if self.consecutive_gids {
445            class_def_2_size.min(self.n_glyphs_in_class(class) * GLYPH_SIZE)
446        } else {
447            class_def_2_size
448        }
449    }
450}
451
452fn count_num_ranges(glyphs: &BTreeSet<GlyphId16>) -> u16 {
453    let mut count = 0;
454    let mut last = None;
455    for gid in glyphs {
456        match (last.take(), gid.to_u16()) {
457            (Some(prev), current) if current == prev + 1 => (), // in same range
458            _ => count += 1, // first glyph or glyph that starts new range
459        }
460        last = Some(gid.to_u16());
461    }
462    count
463}
464
465fn size_of_value_record_children(
466    record: &rgpos::ValueRecord,
467    graph: &Graph,
468    offsets: &[OffsetRecord],
469    // gets incremented every time we see a device offset
470    next_offset_idx: &mut usize,
471    seen: &mut HashSet<ObjectId>,
472) -> usize {
473    let subtables = [
474        record.x_placement_device.get(),
475        record.y_placement_device.get(),
476        record.x_advance_device.get(),
477        record.y_advance_device.get(),
478    ];
479    subtables
480        .iter()
481        .filter_map(|offset| (!offset.is_null()).then_some(*offset.offset()))
482        .map(|_| {
483            let obj = offsets[*next_offset_idx].object;
484            *next_offset_idx += 1;
485            if seen.insert(obj) {
486                graph.objects[&obj].bytes.len()
487            } else {
488                0
489            }
490        })
491        .sum()
492}

494#[cfg(test)]
495mod tests {
496    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
497
498    use read_fonts::{
499        tables::{
500            gpos::{PositionSubtables, ValueFormat},
501            layout::LookupFlag,
502        },
503        FontData, FontRead,
504    };
505
506    use super::*;
507    use crate::{
508        tables::{
509            gpos::{
510                Class1Record, Class2Record, PairPos, PairSet, PairValueRecord, PositionLookup,
511                ValueRecord,
512            },
513            layout::{
514                builders::CoverageTableBuilder, Device, DeviceOrVariationIndex, VariationIndex,
515            },
516        },
517        FontWrite, TableWriter,
518    };
519
520    // a big empty smoke test that constructs a real table and splits it
521    #[test]
522    fn split_pair_pos1() {
523        let _ = env_logger::builder().is_test(true).try_init();
524
525        struct KernPair(GlyphId16, GlyphId16, i16);
526        fn make_pair_pos(pairs: Vec<KernPair>) -> PairPos {
527            let mut records = BTreeMap::new();
528            for KernPair(one, two, kern) in pairs {
529                let value_record1 = ValueRecord::new()
530                    .with_x_advance(kern)
531                    .with_x_placement(kern)
532                    .with_y_advance(kern)
533                    .with_y_placement(kern);
534                records
535                    .entry(one)
536                    .or_insert_with(PairSet::default)
537                    .pair_value_records
538                    .push(PairValueRecord {
539                        second_glyph: two,
540                        value_record1,
541                        value_record2: ValueRecord::default(),
542                    })
543            }
544
545            let coverage: CoverageTableBuilder = records.keys().copied().collect();
546            let pair_sets = records.into_values().collect();
547
548            PairPos::format_1(coverage.build(), pair_sets)
549        }
550
551        const N_GLYPHS: u16 = 1500; // manually determined to cause overflow
552
553        let mut pairs = Vec::new();
554        for (advance, g1) in (0u16..N_GLYPHS).enumerate() {
555            pairs.push(KernPair(
556                GlyphId16::new(g1),
557                GlyphId16::new(5),
558                advance as _,
559            ));
560            pairs.push(KernPair(
561                GlyphId16::new(g1),
562                GlyphId16::new(6),
563                advance as _,
564            ));
565            pairs.push(KernPair(
566                GlyphId16::new(g1),
567                GlyphId16::new(7),
568                advance as _,
569            ));
570            pairs.push(KernPair(
571                GlyphId16::new(g1),
572                GlyphId16::new(8),
573                advance as _,
574            ));
575        }
576
577        let table = make_pair_pos(pairs);
578        let lookup = wlayout::Lookup::new(LookupFlag::empty(), vec![table]);
579        let mut graph = TableWriter::make_graph(&lookup);
580
581        let id = graph.root;
582        split_pair_pos(&mut graph, id);
583        graph.remove_orphans();
584        assert!(graph.basic_sort());
585
586        let bytes = graph.serialize();
587
588        let lookup = rlayout::Lookup::<rgpos::PairPosFormat1>::read(FontData::new(&bytes)).unwrap();
589        assert_eq!(lookup.sub_table_count(), 2);
590        let sub1 = lookup.subtables().get(0).unwrap();
591        let sub2 = lookup.subtables().get(1).unwrap();
592
593        // ensure that the split coverage tables equal the unsplit coverage table
594        let gids = sub1
595            .coverage()
596            .unwrap()
597            .iter()
598            .chain(sub2.coverage().unwrap().iter())
599            .map(GlyphId16::to_u16)
600            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
601        assert_eq!(gids.len(), N_GLYPHS as _);
602
603        let expected = std::iter::successors(Some(0), |n| Some(n + 1))
604            .take(N_GLYPHS as _)
605            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
606        assert_eq!(gids, expected);
607
608        // ensure that the PairSet tables at the split boundaries are as expected
609        assert_eq!(sub1.pair_set_count() + sub2.pair_set_count(), N_GLYPHS);
610    }
611
612    fn make_pairpos_f1_with_device_tables(g1_count: u16, g2_count: u16) -> PairPos {
613        let mut pairsets = Vec::new();
614        for g1 in 1u16..=g1_count {
615            let records = (1..=g2_count)
616                .map(|gid2| {
617                    let val = g2_count * g1 + gid2;
618                    let valrec = ValueRecord::new()
619                        .with_x_advance(val as _)
620                        .with_y_advance(val as _)
621                        .with_x_placement(val as _)
622                        .with_y_advance_device(VariationIndex::new(val, val + 1))
623                        .with_x_advance_device(VariationIndex::new(val, val));
624                    let valrec2 = valrec
625                        .clone()
626                        .with_y_advance_device(VariationIndex::new(
627                            u16::MAX - val,
628                            u16::MAX - val - 1,
629                        ))
630                        .with_x_advance_device(VariationIndex::new(u16::MAX - val, u16::MAX - val));
631                    PairValueRecord::new(GlyphId16::new(gid2), valrec, valrec2)
632                })
633                .collect();
634            pairsets.push(PairSet::new(records));
635        }
636
637        let coverage = (1u16..=g1_count).map(GlyphId16::new).collect();
638        PairPos::format_1(coverage, pairsets)
639    }

641    #[test]
642    fn split_pairpos1_with_device_tables() {
643        let _ = env_logger::builder().is_test(true).try_init();
644        // construct a pp1 table that only requires splitting if you accounted
645        // for device tables. so:
646
647        // use device format with 5 fields, == 10 bytes per valuerecord,
648        // 22 bytes per pairvaluerecord (gid + 2 * value record)
649        // let's have two varidx tables per valuerecord, so...
650        // 24 bytes of subtables (4 * 6)
651        // let's say 100 pair value records per pairset, so:
652        // pairset = (2 + 100 * 22) + (100 * 24) == 4602 bytes
653        // so 15 pairsets (69030) puts us over the limit.
654        const G1_COUNT: u16 = 15;
655        const G2_COUNT: u16 = 100;
656
657        // first just naively check that the split function, called directly,
658        // works as expected
659
660        let table = make_pairpos_f1_with_device_tables(G1_COUNT, G2_COUNT);
661        let lookup = wlayout::Lookup::new(LookupFlag::empty(), vec![table]);
662        let mut graph = TableWriter::make_graph(&lookup);
663
664        assert!(lookup.table_type().is_splittable());
665        let id = graph.root;
666        split_pair_pos(&mut graph, id);
667        graph.remove_orphans();
668        assert!(graph.basic_sort());
669
670        let bytes = graph.serialize();
671
672        let rlookup =
673            rlayout::Lookup::<rgpos::PairPosFormat1>::read(FontData::new(&bytes)).unwrap();
674        assert_eq!(rlookup.sub_table_count(), 2);
675    }

691    #[test]
692    fn count_glyph_ranges() {
693        fn make_input(glyphs: &[u16]) -> BTreeSet<GlyphId16> {
694            glyphs.iter().copied().map(GlyphId16::new).collect()
695        }
696
697        assert_eq!(count_num_ranges(&make_input(&[])), 0);
698        assert_eq!(count_num_ranges(&make_input(&[1])), 1);
699        assert_eq!(count_num_ranges(&make_input(&[1, 2, 3])), 1);
700        assert_eq!(count_num_ranges(&make_input(&[1, 2, 3])), 1);
701        assert_eq!(count_num_ranges(&make_input(&[1, 2, 3, 5])), 2);
702        assert_eq!(count_num_ranges(&make_input(&[1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 10])), 3);
703    }

705    fn dummy_class_def(
706        n_classes: u16,
707        n_glyphs_per_class: u16,
708        first_gid: u16,
709    ) -> wlayout::ClassDef {
710        let n_glyphs = n_classes * n_glyphs_per_class;
711        (first_gid..first_gid + n_glyphs)
712            .map(|gid| {
713                let class = (gid - 1) / n_glyphs_per_class;
714                (GlyphId16::new(gid), class)
715            })
716            .collect()
717    }

719    fn make_pairpos2() -> PositionLookup {
720        fn next_class2_rec(i: usize) -> Class2Record {
721            // idk how better to cast bits directly
722            let val = i16::from_be_bytes(((i % u16::MAX as usize) as u16).to_be_bytes());
723            // we add a device table every twelve records, arbitrary, we
724            // want some but not a ton
725            let value_format = ValueFormat::X_ADVANCE
726                | ValueFormat::Y_ADVANCE
727                | ValueFormat::X_PLACEMENT
728                | ValueFormat::Y_PLACEMENT
729                | ValueFormat::Y_ADVANCE_DEVICE;
730            let add_device = i % 500 == 0;
731            let mut record = ValueRecord::new()
732                .with_explicit_value_format(value_format)
733                .with_x_advance(val)
734                .with_y_advance(val)
735                .with_x_placement(val)
736                .with_y_placement(val);
737            if add_device {
738                record = record.with_y_advance_device(DeviceOrVariationIndex::variation_index(
739                    0xde, val as u16,
740                ));
741            }
742
743            Class2Record {
744                value_record1: record.clone(),
745                value_record2: record,
746            }
747        }
748
749        const CLASS1_COUNT: u16 = 100;
750        const CLASS2_COUNT: u16 = 100;
751
752        let class_def1 = dummy_class_def(CLASS1_COUNT, 4, 1);
753        let class_def2 = dummy_class_def(CLASS2_COUNT, 3, 1);
754
755        assert_eq!(class_def1.class_count(), CLASS1_COUNT);
756        assert_eq!(class_def2.class_count(), CLASS2_COUNT);
757        let coverage = class_def1
758            .iter()
759            .map(|(gid, _)| gid)
760            .collect::<wlayout::CoverageTable>();
761
762        let class1recs = (0..CLASS1_COUNT)
763            .map(|i| {
764                Class1Record::new(
765                    (0..CLASS2_COUNT)
766                        .map(|j| next_class2_rec(i as usize * CLASS1_COUNT as usize + j as usize))
767                        .collect(),
768                )
769            })
770            .collect();
771
772        let table = PairPos::format_2(coverage, class_def1, class_def2, class1recs);
773
774        let lookup = wlayout::Lookup::new(LookupFlag::empty(), vec![table]);
775        PositionLookup::Pair(lookup)
776    }

794    #[test]
795    fn ensure_split_pairpos_f2_works() {
796        let _ = env_logger::builder().is_test(true).try_init();
797
798        // and sanity check that we have the same number of records:
799        let lookup = make_pairpos2();
800        let expected_n_c2_recs = match &lookup {
801            PositionLookup::Pair(pairpos) => pairpos
802                .subtables
803                .iter()
804                .map(|sub| match sub.as_ref() {
805                    PairPos::Format1(_) => 0,
806                    PairPos::Format2(sub) => sub
807                        .class1_records
808                        .iter()
809                        .map(|c1rec| c1rec.class2_records.len())
810                        .sum::<usize>(),
811                })
812                .sum::<usize>(),
813            _ => panic!("wrong lookup type"),
814        };
815        let lookup_list = wlayout::LookupList::new(vec![lookup]);
816        let bytes = crate::dump_table(&lookup_list).unwrap();
817
818        let rlookuplist = rgpos::PositionLookupList::read(FontData::new(&bytes)).unwrap();
819        assert_eq!(rlookuplist.lookup_count(), 1);
820        let rlookup = rlookuplist.lookups().get(0).unwrap();
821        let subtables = match rlookup.subtables().unwrap() {
822            PositionSubtables::Pair(subs) => subs.iter().map(|sub| match sub.unwrap() {
823                rgpos::PairPos::Format2(sub) => sub,
824                rgpos::PairPos::Format1(_) => panic!("wrong subtable type"),
825            }),
826            _ => panic!("wrong lookup type"),
827        };
828        let total_c2recs: usize = subtables
829            .map(|sub| {
830                sub.class1_records()
831                    .iter()
832                    .map(|c1rec| c1rec.unwrap().class2_records.len())
833                    .sum::<usize>()
834            })
835            .sum();
836        assert_eq!(total_c2recs, expected_n_c2_recs);
837    }

839    #[test]
840    fn size_of_value_record_children_sanity() {
841        // let's have  single class1class, and three class2 classes
842        // we want a duplicate varidx, a null varidx, and a device table?
843
844        fn val_record_with_xadv(x_advance: i16) -> ValueRecord {
845            let format = ValueFormat::X_ADVANCE | ValueFormat::X_ADVANCE_DEVICE;
846            ValueRecord::new()
847                .with_explicit_value_format(format)
848                .with_x_advance(x_advance)
849        }
850
851        // number of classes, number of glyphs per class, GID of first glyph
852        let class_def1 = dummy_class_def(1, 4, 1);
853        let class_def2 = dummy_class_def(3, 3, 1);
854        let coverage = class_def1.iter().map(|(gid, _)| gid).collect();
855        let actual_device_table = Device::new(12, 15, &[118, 119, 127, 99]);
856        // sanity check the size of the device table, these are weird:
857        assert_eq!(crate::dump_table(&actual_device_table).unwrap().len(), 10);
858        let class1_records = vec![Class1Record::new(vec![
859            Class2Record::new(
860                val_record_with_xadv(5),
861                val_record_with_xadv(6)
862                    .with_x_advance_device(DeviceOrVariationIndex::variation_index(4, 20)),
863            ),
864            Class2Record::new(
865                val_record_with_xadv(7)
866                    .with_x_advance_device(DeviceOrVariationIndex::Device(actual_device_table)),
867                // a duplicate table
868                val_record_with_xadv(8)
869                    .with_x_advance_device(DeviceOrVariationIndex::variation_index(4, 20)),
870            ),
871            Class2Record::new(
872                val_record_with_xadv(9)
873                    .with_x_advance_device(DeviceOrVariationIndex::variation_index(6, 9)),
874                val_record_with_xadv(10),
875            ),
876        ])];
877        let ppf2 = PairPos::format_2(coverage, class_def1, class_def2, class1_records);
878
879        // now we need to pretend we're in the split_pair_pos_format_2 fn
880        let mut graph = TableWriter::make_graph(&ppf2);
881        assert!(graph.pack_objects());
882        let root_id = graph.root;
883        let ppf2_data = &graph.objects[&root_id];
884        let ppf2 = ppf2_data.reparse::<rgpos::PairPosFormat2>().unwrap();
885        assert_eq!(ppf2.class1_records().len(), 1);
886        let c1rec = ppf2.class1_records().get(0).unwrap();
887        let mut visited = HashSet::new();
888        let mut next_device_offset = 3;
889        assert_eq!(c1rec.class2_records.len(), 3);
890
891        // a little helper so we don't have to have this huge fn call in each assert
892        let mut children_size = |record: &rgpos::ValueRecord| -> usize {
893            size_of_value_record_children(
894                record,
895                &graph,
896                &ppf2_data.offsets,
897                &mut next_device_offset,
898                &mut visited,
899            )
900        };
901
902        let c2rec1 = c1rec.class2_records().get(0).unwrap();
903        assert_eq!(children_size(c2rec1.value_record1()), 0, "no subtables");
904        assert_eq!(children_size(c2rec1.value_record2()), 6, "one new varidx");
905        let c2rec2 = c1rec.class2_records().get(1).unwrap();
906        assert_eq!(children_size(c2rec2.value_record1()), 10, "a device table");
907        assert_eq!(children_size(c2rec2.value_record2()), 0, "duplicate table");
908        let c2rec3 = c1rec.class2_records().get(2).unwrap();
909        assert_eq!(children_size(c2rec3.value_record1()), 6, "new varidx table");
910        assert_eq!(children_size(c2rec3.value_record2()), 0, "a null offset");
911        assert_eq!(next_device_offset, 7, "we visited all offsets");
912    }
